title: RBAC Core: app/core/permissions.py, hierarchical user provisioning API, parent-student links, and center_admin role migration
assumptions: Role 'center_admin' is introduced alongside 'admin' with full backward compatibility.
center_admin can only create and manage users within their own center.
Accessing resources belonging to other centers returns 404 Not Found to prevent tenant data leakage.
Parent-student links strictly require both users to belong to the same center.
